name: ds-stack
description: Data-science skills that make agent work trustworthy: check scripts and a fixed readout for analyses (ds-mode), a checker for finished readouts (ds-verify), a cross-model second opinion that keeps only proven findings (ds-interrogate), a readiness audit for a work project (ds-ready), and structure, format, concision and reader tests for documents (ds-doc, doc-tighten, cold-read).
